branches.finite_wait: Update accumulates finite wait and reflects the flowed state; T equals that wait.
branches.zero_wait: Λ(0)=0 and e=0 give τ=0; the update still applies S at Φ(0,z)=z, with no positive-time guard in recursion. B excludes zero waits.
branches.top_wait: The next record becomes stopped. W retains top for an active input with no hit; T defaults to zero at top. B excludes top because d is finite.
branches.stopped: Stopped state is absorbing under next; W=T=ρ=0. If the last history record is stopped then D=0 and the sequence does not belong to B.
branches.zero_cap: d(h)=0 makes D(h,·)=0; B excludes sequences whose history has zero cap.
branches.zero_gradient_difference: Total division makes the reflection velocity correction zero when g_r(x)=0; S leaves that state unchanged and its instantaneous rate is zero.
branches.zero_dimension: Allowed by all instances. All vectors and gradients vanish; rates and accumulated rates vanish; positive thresholds have top waits while threshold zero has zero wait. The strict-event measure and capped density vanish.
branches.n_zero: History has one initial record; fresh coordinate is w 0.
branches.negative_raw_coordinate: toNNReal converts it to zero for W and Λ; the raw density's Φ is evaluated at the negative real. The capped density D is zero at every nonpositive real.

literal_definition_audit.name: c
literal_definition_audit.literal_lean: let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
literal_definition_audit.meaning: c(y,r)=y-eta gradient V(r), source proximal-reference center.

literal_definition_audit.name: Φ
literal_definition_audit.literal_lean:
let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
literal_definition_audit.meaning: Literal harmonic flow with cos/sin and sqrt eta scaling, for every real time; no time rescaling.

literal_definition_audit.name: S
literal_definition_audit.literal_lean:
let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
literal_definition_audit.meaning: Literal gradient-difference reflection with coefficient2; total real division gives identity at gradient difference0.

literal_definition_audit.name: rate
literal_definition_audit.literal_lean:
let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
literal_definition_audit.meaning: sqrt eta times positive part of velocity-gradient inner product; not absolute value or an assumed hazard.

literal_definition_audit.name: Λ
literal_definition_audit.literal_lean:
let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
literal_definition_audit.meaning: Real interval integral from0 to finite NNReal time of actual rate along actual flow.

literal_definition_audit.name: τ
literal_definition_audit.literal_lean:
let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
      MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
        (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
          Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
        (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
literal_definition_audit.meaning: hittingAfter closed nonnegative target for Lambda-e from0; infimum empty is top; e0 may produce wait0.

literal_definition_audit.name: next
literal_definition_audit.literal_lean:
let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
      match r with
      | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
      | Sum.inl a =>
        if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
          Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,

boundary_cases.stopped: Stopped state is absorbing under next; W=T=ρ=0. If the last history record is stopped then D=0 and the sequence does not belong to B.
boundary_cases.zero_cap: d(h)=0 makes D(h,·)=0; B excludes sequences whose history has zero cap.
boundary_cases.zero_gradient_difference: Total division makes the reflection velocity correction zero when g_r(x)=0; S leaves that state unchanged and its instantaneous rate is zero.
boundary_cases.zero_dimension: Allowed by all instances. All vectors and gradients vanish; rates and accumulated rates vanish; positive thresholds have top waits while threshold zero has zero wait. The strict-event measure and capped density vanish.
boundary_cases.n_zero: History has one initial record; fresh coordinate is w 0.
boundary_cases.negative_raw_coordinate: toNNReal converts it to zero for W and Λ; the raw density's Φ is evaluated at the negative real. The capped density D is zero at every nonpositive real.
